identity.hoa_name: THE SANCTUARY AT PINECREST MAINTENANCE ASSOCIATION, INC.
identity.notes: Boutique single-family gated community of only 12 residences in the northern part of the Village of Pinecrest (Miami-Dade County), HOA established July 5, 1994. Known for distinctive architecture, beautifully finished homes, pools, and sizable lots. Centrally situated between Coral Gables and Palmetto Bay, minutes from Downtown Miami. HOA address: 11061 SW 59th Ct, Miami, FL 33156; Federal ID 650781214; managed by FPMS (5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota, FL 34231, 941-960-5000).
